title: Road playback and dashboard replies on 0.4.7
route_fixture: Saved synthetic Berlin to Potsdam route; earlier live Valhalla geometry, 31.21 km

configuration.dashboard: Fake dashboard on loopback, serving malformed replies

limitations: One physical phone, one route, one provider response. The run covered the first 3.54 km of 31.21 km and did not reach the destination. The 60 km/h phase lasted 11.51 s. Replies came over loopback HTTP from a fake dashboard, not over HTTPS. Polling sees most fixes, not necessarily all. Delivery to other apps not measured.
deviations: Malformed dashboard replies were served during the session. Reply times were not logged, so the first poll may have come just before Start.
